description: Public site (tapefund.com) is static — rebuilt from logs/ at deploy time. Daily automations commit logs to main but do NOT trigger Vercel unless [deploy-site] is in the commit message or web/ changed.

schedule.primary: Friday 17:00 ET — Ackman Calibration automation (#6) commits with [deploy-site] and runs scripts/trigger-site-deploy.sh
schedule.backup: GitHub Action deploy-site-friday.yml — Friday 21:35 UTC if hook secret is configured

setup.vercelDeployHook: Vercel → investing-robinhood → Settings → Git → Deploy Hooks → main → copy URL to VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK
setup.cursorAutomationEnv: Optional: same VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK for Cloud Agent trigger-site-deploy.sh
